title: ZuCo 1.0: Simultaneous EEG and Eye-Tracking during Natural Reading
description: ZuCo 1.0 is a multimodal neuroimaging dataset combining simultaneous 128-channel EEG and eye-tracking recordings from adult native English speakers during natural sentence reading. The dataset encompasses three reading tasks: sentiment rating of movie reviews, naturalistic reading of Wikipedia sentences, and task-specific reading with semantic relation annotation. This resource enables investigation of neural and oculomotor correlates of language processing during naturalistic reading.
methods_description: Data were collected using 128-channel EEG (EGI Geodesic, 500 Hz sampling rate, Cz reference) and eye-tracking (EyeLink 1000, 500 Hz sampling rate, left eye recording). Participants were adult native English speakers. Eye-tracking data include gaze and pupil samples recorded simultaneously with EEG, with fixations, saccades, and blinks annotated in event files.
